import unittest
import shipment_order as app

class Behavior(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_calendar_order(self):
        rows = [{'id': 'B', 'ship_date': '02/02/2026'}, {'id': 'A', 'ship_date': '31/01/2026'}, {'id': 'C', 'ship_date': '30/12/2025'}]
        result = app.sort_shipments(rows)
        self.assertEqual([r['id'] for r in result], ['C', 'A', 'B'])
        self.assertEqual([r['id'] for r in rows], ['B', 'A', 'C'])
        self.assertIs(result[0], rows[2])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], {'id': 'B', 'ship_date': '02/02/2026'})
    def test_ties_leap_and_empty(self):
        rows = [{'id': 'x', 'ship_date': '01/03/2024'}, {'id': 'y', 'ship_date': '29/02/2024'}, {'id': 'z', 'ship_date': '29/02/2024'}]
        self.assertEqual([r['id'] for r in app.sort_shipments(rows)], ['y', 'z', 'x'])
        self.assertEqual(app.sort_shipments([]), [])

    def test_additional_behavior(self):
        rows = [{'id': 'S4', 'ship_date': '01/03/2024'}, {'id': 'R9', 'ship_date': '29/02/2024'}, {'id': 'P2', 'ship_date': '29/02/2024'}]
        before = [dict(row) for row in rows]
        result = app.sort_shipments(rows)
        self.assertEqual([r['id'] for r in result], ['R9', 'P2', 'S4'])
        self.assertEqual(rows, before)
        for returned, original in zip(result, [rows[1], rows[2], rows[0]]):
            self.assertIs(returned, original)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
